# INTERLOCK_TRUTH_TABLE (generated by Hardware/build/gen_truth.py)

Source of logic: the AND-gate connections U8..U12 read from Hardware/build/design.py, the same data that generated the schematic and PCB netlist; PCB pad nets of U8,U10,U11 were separately read back from NIGHTHAWK.kicad_pcb in CORRECTED_PIN_MAPPING.md.

Equations extracted: ARM_WDG = ARM AND EN (U8); LOOPS_OK = LOOP_OK AND ENCL_OK (U9); INTERLOCK_OK = ARM_WDG AND LOOPS_OK (U10); RF1_PWR_ON = INTERLOCK_OK AND RF1_EN (U11); RF2_PWR_ON = INTERLOCK_OK AND RF2_EN (U12)

EN is the ESP32 EN net driven by TPS3823 /RESET (active-low output). EN=0 means the MCU is in reset (reset button on /MR, supply below threshold, or watchdog time-out).

Exhaustive check over 64 input combinations: rows where a module rail is ON although a required condition is false = 0. Rows with any module rail ON = 3 (all have ARM=EN=LOOP_OK=ENCL_OK=1 and the matching RFx_EN=1).

## B. Fault conditions (what drives the inputs of table A)

TPS3823 timing from TI SLVS165O: watchdog time-out ttout 0.9 / 1.6 / 2.5 s (min/typ/max), reset delay td 120 / 200 / 300 ms, supply threshold 2.93 V for the -33 option.

| # | Condition | Effect on inputs | Rails | Mechanism | Evidence level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | USB not connected / power-up ramp | All logic unpowered; RFx_PWR_ON pulled to GND by 10k (R on each load-switch ON net) | OFF | Pull-down on TPS22918 ON pin (ON is active-high, VIL max 0.5 V per datasheet) | Netlist + datasheet; not measured |
| 2 | 3V3 below 2.93 V (brown-out / start-up) | TPS3823 /RESET low, EN=0 | OFF | Table A rows with EN=0 | Datasheet + netlist; not measured |
| 3 | Idle after boot | ARM=0 (GPIO10 input at reset with 10k pull-down, firmware drives 0) | OFF | ARM AND gate | Netlist; GPIO10 is not a strapping pin (ESP32-C3-WROOM-02 datasheet v1.7 Sect. 4) |
| 4 | Reset button pressed | /MR low, /RESET low, EN=0 | OFF | U8 = ARM AND EN | Netlist |
| 5 | MCU reset (software or EN pulled low from DEBUG header) | EN=0; after reset ARM is high-impedance, held low by 10k | OFF until firmware re-arms | Same gate; ARM is not retained by the MCU across reset | Netlist; reset-time GPIO state is datasheet-class behaviour, not measured |
| 6 | Watchdog time-out (no falling edge on WDI) | /RESET low for td, EN=0 | OFF, MCU reboots with ARM=0 | TPS3823 WDI | Datasheet + netlist; not measured |
| 7 | Interlock loop open (J6 pins 1-2 jumper removed or cable cut) | LOOP_OK pulled to GND by 10k | OFF | U9/U10 | Netlist |
| 8 | Enclosure open (J6 pins 3-4) | ENCL_OK pulled to GND by 10k | OFF | U9/U10 | Netlist |
| 9 | J6 unplugged entirely | Both loop inputs low | OFF | Pull-downs | Netlist |
| 10 | TCA9555 I2C failure / expander at power-up (all pins inputs with internal pull-up) | RFx_EN has external 10k pull-down against internal pull-up; datasheet figure shows 100 kOhm, so level is about 0.3 V (below VIL 0.3 x VCC = 0.99 V) | OFF | Divider | Datasheet figure value assumed typical; not measured |
| 11 | Firmware hangs with WDI no longer toggled | Same as 6 | OFF | Hardware watchdog | As 6 |
| 12 | Application stalled while a timer/ISR still toggles WDI | Not possible with the current firmware: WDI is toggled only by the supervisor, and only while every critical task has reported progress inside its deadline (WATCHDOG_TASK_HEALTH_MATRIX.md). A blocked sampler or CLI command stops WDI and drops ARM | ARM low within the task deadline | Software supervisor + hardware gate; host-simulated only (FIRMWARE_TEST_REPORT.md T2a/T2b) | Host simulation; not tested on hardware |
| 13 | Single-point failure of a gate (output stuck high) or load switch shorted | Not detectable | May stay ON | No redundancy: U10 feeds both U11 and U12 | Known limitation |
| 14 | SPI/I2C signals driven while a module rail is OFF | Signals can partially power an unpowered module through its input protection diodes | Not gated | Series resistors / bus switch absent | Known limitation, open item for REV B |

## C. Statement of what firmware can and cannot do
Firmware can drive ARM and RFx_EN high. It cannot turn a rail on when LOOP_OK, ENCL_OK or EN is low, nor keep a rail on through a reset. It can keep a rail on if it hangs while still toggling WDI (row 12). The board contains no RF transmitter, amplifier or ESL command generator; the module sockets are empty.
